notes.title: Season 4 is Live!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=rOEK1AjiKYI;full][/previewyoutube]
Join Season 4! Deploy the stealthy Nighthawk Operator, dominate with airborne gear through fresh Operator Customization, and wield the adaptable AS VAL Rifle—transform it into the legendary silent Vintorez or the rapid-striking Vikhr. Pilot the agile MH-6 Helicopter, claim deadly tactical blades and elite aviation equipment!

Meet new Nighthawk Operator!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/3a8f8bb473294cedf5022b1dfbbb881fcddb7c3b.png
Elevate your battlefield presence with all-new Operator Customization options inspired by Elite Aviation Gear. Choose from tactical helmets, sleek pilot visors, authentic flight jackets, and combat-ready tactical vests. Mix and match gear to create your ultimate airborne warrior. Gear up and dominate the skies!

New Rifle — AS VAL, Vintorez, Vikhr!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/686b528aa69df58c256dd66aa8c7d17344733f32.png
Customize the adaptable new AS VAL rifle — equip tactical scopes and built-in suppressors to wield the legendary stealthy Vintorez, or shorten the barrel and add ergonomic grips for the compact, rapid-striking Vikhr. Silence or speed — dominate your way!

Claim S4 Rewards: Own the Air, Control the Ground!
Unleash precision weaponry, elite aviation gear, and tactical blades designed for aerial supremacy. From iconic pilot helmets and legendary flight jackets to deadly butterfly knives and customized firearms—gear up, take flight, and rule from above!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/b40693328fc0b64390d5ce59313c1bd5bc52c04f.png
"Whoever owns the skies, owns the fight."

Kick off with the new Starter Pack 2 Bundle!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/f187472f727a0add6da56ac94fa4bec4a65bcec1.png
Ready for a match? This starter bundle has all the firepower you need to put you on a level pitch. Note: This Bundle weapons have Emerald Tracer rounds.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/61bbe77b377ada82fc596415c618cefe8ce93034.png
"Stand proud, fight loud!"
Equip sleek, urban-camo firearms with green laser sights and tracer rounds, brutal melee bats and more! Gear up with the iconic Whiteout Jacket, tactical sunglasses, and the fierce Spectre Mask! Stand out, strike hard, and make every fight feel like match day!

New Vehicle — Helicopter Incoming!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/b795a2ead26da690ff358aba36689e9922c90f63.png
Pilot your way to victory with the powerful New MH-6 Helicopter! Fast, agile, and deadly—customize it with unique tactical skins, dominate the skies, and unleash aerial havoc. Elevate your tactics, claim air superiority, and rule from above!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/3e091c4977458b1a855f5d49610ef3dff58151af.png

New version highlights:
- New Weapons AS VAL, Vintorez, Vikhr!
- Meet New Operator -- Nighthawk!
- Customize your Operators with New Aviation Accessories!
- Fly Helicopter with new MH-6!
- New Oil Platfroms locations!
- More performance optimizations!

Enjoy the New Season 4! More to come!

Thank you for your love and greatest support,
Lets go!
Alfa Bravo Team

notes.title: New Maps! New Graphics! HD Remaster is here!
notes.content:
1. OIL DEPOT -- Where One Spark Means Game Over.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/9364f663a6cfed014527bc001eb2cfcba675ea3a.jpg
A high-risk industrial warzone. Use fuel tankers and pipelines as cover, navigate the tight alleyways, and control key vantage points. Every move counts when everything around you is flammable.

2. HANGAR -- CQB Chaos in a Kill Box.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/7ea81ca8d336ea38a40b710b9657b46c9d37f142.jpg
Tight corridors, elevated sightlines, and fast-paced flanking routes make for relentless, no-respawn combat. Control the upper decks, or get pinned down below. This is where gunfights are decided in milliseconds.

3. POOL -- Silent Depths. Sudden Death.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/31183c3c9120a822d1ed4915e97315ec7aaeca0e.jpg
Tactical chaos meets unexpected terrain. Clear the locker rooms, or take the fight to the deep end—yes, wet combat is in play. Keep your eyes peeled… the enemy might be lurking the tub!

4. CARGO -- A Steel Jungle of Firefights.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/d5111d6d575104f6b14f70b8c9e50b0ea010e4c9.jpg
A labyrinth of stacked containers in a sprawling seaport. Tight angles, brutal crossfire, and vertical gameplay define this map. Move fast, check your corners, and control the high ground—or end up in a shipping manifest.

New Maps! New Graphics! Join the HD Remaster Now!

New in this version
Dear Players! HD Remaster is here! Enjoy 4 new maps with AAA graphics!
-- Oil Depot HD
-- Hangar HD
-- Pool HD
-- Cargo HD

Thank you for your love and greatest support,
Lets go!
Alfa Bravo Team

notes.title: Hunter Drone, Killchains, Operator and more!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/08d16bcd62b330cfcee194c8e43b59257867a051.jpg
Command the skies with the Tactical Hunter Drone, striking enemies every 3 kills! Unleash all 3 kill chains—Hunter Drone, Minigun, and Nuke—in one loadout. Get the Drone Master Bundle with the new Falcon Operator, Maverick AK with Dragon Breath Rounds, Vector Overkill with Arctic Blue Tracers, and more. Take control and bring the chaos!

New Kill Chain: Tactical Hunter Drone!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/0b4595d16fc171fdd941b3b1df393d9a593317c8.jpg
Meet the Tactical Hunter Drone, your eyes in the sky and a fierce force on the ground! This advanced drone autonomously locks onto enemies, swooping down with deadly precision. Make 3 kills and release the Hunter! Unleash the skies and let the drone do the dirty work. Deploy, destroy, and dominate!

Why settle for one kill chain when you can unleash all three? You can now stack the power of three unique kill chains in a single loadout! Hunter Drone, Minigun and Nuke all at once! More kill chains to come!

Get the new Drone Master Bundle!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/b7b8244235c76cf69dbe6e5346d644d81203534b.jpg
Take flight with Drone and an explosive aerial arsenal! With precision strikes from new Falcon Operator, the rogue power of AK-conversion Maverick and its [color=#EED74F]Dragon Breath Rounds[/color], firepower overload in Vector Overkill with [color=#458AFF]Arctic Blue Tracers[/color], and razor-sharp control in Akimbo Axes Rotors, you’ll be unstoppable!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/e147cf749a93d5db6688039b08161cb061580f12.jpg
Eyes on the horizon, target in my sights— Ready to bring the chaos from above!
Command the skies with Flyboy Wristwatch, bring a ghostly edge with Wraith Drone, and unleash the sting of Throwing Wasps! Own the skies — grab the Drone Master now!

New version highlights:
Dear Players! The Drone Master update is here!

-- New Kill Chain: Tactical Hunter Drone!
-- Now stack 3 Kill Chains in a single loadout, including the New Hunter Drone, Minigun, and Nuke!

notes.title: Halloween in COMBAT MASTER
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/c8730eb1db25814048121bff6790f1d157bb1f0a.jpg
Gear up for the spookiest update yet! Vaporize enemies with the Rail Gun, dominate the new Fight Yard mode. Wield the fearsome Akimbo Axes and unleash the Pumpkin Triplets—Aberration, John O. Lantern, and Pincushion! Use the new Collections feature, and get ready for more as Halloween Part 2 approaches! Happy Haunting!

Unleash the Power of the Rail Gun!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/5dc3fa1efb08ada3b7c7fb055f54660b285daf4b.jpg
Bring the heat with the all-new Rail Gun! Harness high-powered precision to obliterate enemies in one unique devastating Atomic Rail Tracer shot. Ready. Aim. Vaporize! 

Dominate the Fight Yard Arena!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/790d6acba81143603a9f6b81a8bcda987d08def7.jpg
Enter the Fight Yard, special Halloween Game Mode! Battle in the new fast-paced, all-out arena where only the strongest survive. Grab the best blueprint weapons, fly the jump-pads, teleport and fight for supremacy! Capture the Rail Gun spot and show your art of being supreme!

Haunt the Skies with the New Map!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/573ce6e42b5c20488488f0af4c624aed2091b792.jpg
Welcome to Heavens, the ultimate battleground in the sky! Fight on floating platforms with high-altitude combat and fierce aerial maneuvers. Only the bold survive in this heavenly chaos!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/cbd947d46e4b81e44b9219ff5ca57a400f87ce9a.jpg
Use the new Teleports, Heavy Armor, Jump-pads and the Best Weapon Blueprints including the new Rail Gun -- all in one place! Rise to skies!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/bb3b7e6b2f92503121cf9313691942575cb91f62.jpg
Activate the 24/7 Heavens Fight Yard filter and vaporize your enemies in the sky-high chaos of this Heavenly Arena!

Twice the Terror with Akimbo Axes!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/fd0f8278aaeb72d207623aac1404c6d42df9af69.jpg
Unleash double the destruction with Akimbo Axes! Dual-wield devastating melee power and slice through the competition with twice the style! Why stop at one? Go ahead and give it a whirl with every Axe in the game — because two is always better than one!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/5db3c3ab5800c2f0a37455509f207d3e76cbdc18.jpg

Get the new Pumpkin Triplets Bundle!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/b489484ae85d4495d23d44593b2f9ce5922ff8d2.jpg
Call the Three Pumpkin Brothers! Get ready to terrorize with Aberration, take down enemies with the eerie power of John O. Lantern, and ensure they get the point with Pincushion. Grab the bundle and bring the nightmare to life!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/3814fd178ac3e31b475c3e351d18009ac8be4bc2.jpg
Stare, scare, and beware—unleash the Pumpkin Heads!
Time to smash! Show them you're alive... but they won't be for long! Note: This Bundle weapons have Ruby Tracer rounds and Burning Fire Effect.

Vaporize with the new Rail Gun Bundle!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/53da63a43729bb5de13968bdcc5fd5cefd09d393.jpg
Use this deadly weapon set to blast through enemies before they even know what hit them. Note: This Bundle weapons have Atomic Rail Tracer rounds.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/00988086b9b6ab5990084fcf4cdb3abb78b2b872.jpg
One shot, one apocalypse. The Rail Gun doesn't miss!
Now, clap for your skill — or the sheer stupidity of your enemies — while wielding the new Clapper Akimbo Axes in the form of hands! Hands in your hands, genius! Truly, I’m applauding!

Collect and Equip like never before!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/af220f6fe18b3af47a396b0f411d50683823a817.jpg
Dear Collectors, collect them all! With the new Collections, managing your Arsenal is easier than ever! Browse and equip Weapons, Operators, and all your gear! Or even entire Collection Sets with just one click!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/b9571f6d6f9c635fbfb56d70b6e1929a5315eb16.jpg
Now that’s progress! Track your Collector's stats and gather 100% of the items in the game! First Season, Second Season, Featured, and Favorites — all collections in one place, just for you!

New version highlights:
Dear Players! The new Halloween Part 1 update is here!

- Rail Gun: Vaporize your Eneimies!
- New Special Game Mode: Fight Yard!
- New Map: Heavens Arena
- Akimbo Axes
- New Operators: Pumpkin Triplets!
- Get new bundles: Pumpkin Heads and Rail Rider!
- New Collections Feature
- All the Lasers are now free, Special Thanks to the community #freelasers movement!

And many more fixes and optimizations!

Halloween Part 2 is coming! And the Season 3 is very very close!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/efc8877b168d3d04c2bfd75b1b092041994414af.jpg

Thank you for your love and greatest support,
Lets go!
Alfa Bravo Team

notes.title: Season 2: Laser Strike
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/6e491d45dddf87eae36157ebcbdf02e968b312cf.png
Gear up with Tactical Lasers, dive into the new Kill Confirmed mode, and explore new Cargo and Cargo Night maps. Experience Nighttime Battle Royale on oil rigs and tackle Operation Kraken with the new Nightshade Operator. Localization is now available in 35 languages! Let’s go!

New Lasers! Illuminate Your Game!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/9d60c1f457a6aa63062223876c2e98b8ba9bb95a.jpg
Light up the battlefield with Lasers! Equip the new 5 tactical lasers on your Rifles and Pistols. Switch to canted ADS for faster target acquisition, and dominate the battlefield with enhanced accuracy. Gear up with laser equipment and light up your game!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/2bc826e4f424a239c9dd8f75fc2de63b8c2aae0c.jpg

Join the new Game Mode: Kill Confirmed!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/4a6cf598e8a3ebaa649feff0da108102e5e7ba74.jpg
Welcome to the new Kill Confirmed game mode! Take down enemies, grab their dog-tags, and prevent your team’s losses by denying theirs. Every tag counts—will you claim victory or let it slip away?

New Map Cargo -- conquer the chaos!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/cca6e7fbf7217eb30fa6895d68da6eea6f302462.jpg
Get ready for non-stop action on the new Cargo map! Battle it out on the tanker deck, dodge between containers, and dominate the platform. Can you conquer the chaos at sea?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/e30131cd2ce22d42074286f228c01e1e58bbdbb7.jpg
With tight spaces and elevated platforms, this close-quarters map challenges players to navigate narrow pathways, crates, and containers for intense, action-packed combat. Perfect for fast firefights and tactical play.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/8a1afe5f90dba2b487244d121596596634f262ec.jpg
Use the 24/7 Cargo Kill Confirmed game filter to claim dog-tags around the clock, day and night!

Battle Royale at Night: Dive into the Action!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/a185c3d49680aa285ed3b7bc03c8d44d89dc77f3.jpg
Drop in on the Oil Platform—at night! The darkened environment enhances stealth gameplay, as you navigate dimly lit walkways and shadowy structures, using the cover of night to outsmart your opponents. Can you dominate the COMBATZONE in the dark?

Operation Kraken: Master the Art of Infiltration!
Infiltration is often a very dark art.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/76bae2b3eceec61e5f9c8b8ab1475f377efcc0bd.jpg
Step into the shadows with new Kraken Operation, where infiltration is an art form. As night falls on an offshore oil rig, you’ll face terrorists with plans for destruction. Use cunning and stealth to neutralize threats, gather intel, and complete missions!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/8e0de8904b261ecf407be83a7b50088600c8ee8a.jpg
Claim free rewards and up to 2640 Combat Points! You're the ruler of the shadows and the sea. Join the operation now and show the world what it means to be a true covert ops legend!

Get the new Laser Strike Operator Bundle!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/0b8d61ed2904a172fea5db1d056dea9efdd040e0.jpg
Goes best with Kraken Operation
Answer the call of the deep with these waterproof weapons, ready to wreak havoc as you emerge from the swamp, sand, or sea. Note: This Bundle weapons have Lasers and Emerald Tracer rounds.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/caa8aa6c63aaa4a30bd94258ca94f9ce05e5c5cf.jpg
From the shadows, I strike.
In silence, I conquer.
Meet Nightshade, the newest operator to join the fight! Hailing from the elite Dutch frogmen special ops team, he brings stealth and precision to the battlefield. With unmatched skills in covert operations, he’s ready to strike from the shadows. Are you ready to harness his power? Gear up and unlock Nightshade today!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/810aef853e23b05d1c8855b24bca4400a9c73b98.gif

Gear up with the New Storm Trident Case
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/da89a3c794a2500134026b451181fe4bb658ca7e.jpg
Introducing the Storm Trident Weapon Case! Dive into the depths of naval covert ops with this exclusive gear, featuring sleek designs and tactical laser enhancements for every mission. Don’t just play; dominate with style! Grab your Storm Trident case now and equip yourself for victory!

Join the Global Combat on 35 languages!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/3bcdc64a58de53c667db6ea223c13c1e51a81c0a.jpg
Hello, World! The wait is over—Combat Master is now available in 35 languages<! Play in your native language and take on players from all over the globe. Ready to join the ultimate FPS international community? Dive in and show the world what you've got! Let’s go!

New version highlights:
Dear Players! The new Laser-lit update is here!

- Tactical Lasers for your weapons!
- New Game Mode: Kill Confirmed!
- New Maps: Cargo and Cargo Night
- Drop in Battle Royale at Night on Oil Rigs!
- New Operator: Nightshade
- Operation Kraken: Infiltrate the Oil Platform at night!
- Get the Laser Strike Operator bundle!
- Localization for 35 languages is here! Play in your native language around the globe!

And many more fixes and optimizations!

Rev up your Battle Pass -- Season 3 is coming!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/329147fea39bf07ea1037ef3dc755c7c0bc7ec4b.jpg

Thank you for your love and greatest support,
Lets go!
Alfa Bravo Team

notes.title: Capture the Flag: Jurassic Party Update!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=Vs52I8HPirI;full][/previewyoutube]
Dear Players, the new update is here! Join the new Capture the Flag game mode! Play on the new Museum Map. Finish the new Jurassic Party Operation, get the new T-Rex Operator, and many more! Let's gooooooooooo!

New Game Mode: Capture the Flag!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/5994d7dacfd704e54afde869e2ae8ddee02a863b.jpg
Get ready to dominate with the all-new Capture the Flag mode! It's the ultimate test of strategy, speed, and skill. Race across the map, and secure victory by grabbing the enemy's flag while protecting your own. Whether you're leading the charge or holding the line, teamwork is key. Are you up for the challenge? Flag captured, game on!

New Map: Explore the Museum!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/4f7b2285e9c81fef18c530474833c3051f56bd25.jpg
Step back in time -- and into the action -- in our newest map, Museum. This intense battlefield is set inside a sprawling natural history museum, where history meets mayhem. The centerpiece? A massive T-Rex skeleton towering in the grand gallery, offering both cover and a strategic vantage point.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/48d227e7096b39d5a2bfbadbdd79bd2ae728bbb7.jpg
On one side, a mammoth skull with colossal tusks looms in a cavernous room, perfect for close-quarters combat. On the other, an enormous T-Rex skull grins menacingly, adding a prehistoric thrill to every firefight. Get ready to hunt or be hunted in this epic clash of the ages!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/5c7f5e74d3687fc36178715636533027aef62106.jpg
Use the 24/7 Museum Capture the Flag game filter, to enter the epic non-stop fight through the ages!

Join the new Jurrasic Party Operation!
The party was the time of my life.
200 million years of time, to be exact.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/e0950909cde4add1ad91a244c2262650d3f2b2f1.jpg
The city is having a grand opening thing for its new natural history museum. Your friend Gina works for the city, and she wants someone young to talk to. She didn't mention that it was also a costume party...
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/a73bf9730bc754cbd54f61ee4a3cb1d2222faf94.jpg
But what is the humming coming from the basement? And what did the mayor mean when he said he was doing some research of his own? Your choices alone will determine whether or not this gala is one for the history books.

Get the New T-Rex Operator Bundle!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/3a5ea0dcfe67c5abd9e72c367200627036a17a53.jpg
These candy-colored, cardbacked catastrophes will cause opposing forces to quickly go extinct. This bundle also features the cuddly, carnivorous Rawr operator!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/7511cf98f314ffe3db8c8746e6e77dfd31f5aeab.jpg
Don’t let the toy-inspired designs fool you. These weapons are as lethal as you imagined they might be back when you were six years old.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/9cbfb88d823170d0a08c7e51f6164c3a97f5b647.gif

Join the Custom Loadouts Weapon Mode!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/99f594d9fea818dcdac1d009383e80110c0b711c.jpg
Get ready to amp up your game with Custom Loadout Lobbies! Imagine playing exactly the way you want: Snipers only, Pistols only, or even a wild Knives-only battle. The combinations are endless! What’s next -- gravity mods!? Who knows! Get out there, have a blast (with Thermite-only?), and good luck!

New version highlights:
Dear Players! The new update is here!

- New Game Mode: Capture The Flag
- New Map: Museum
- New Operator: T-Rex
- Operation Jurassic Party
- Dino-themed bundle
- New Custom Lodout Game Mode: Play Snipers only, Pistols only, or even a wild Knives-only battle!

And many more fixes and optimizations!

We're gaining momentum with regular updates -- more to come next weeks!

Thank you for your love and greatest support,
Lets go!
Alfa Bravo Team

notes.title: SEASON 2 is now LIVE!
notes.content:
Drop in SEASON 2 of Combat Master!
[previewyoutube=98Bc1f6McFc;full][/previewyoutube]
After much anticipation, we are thrilled to announce Season 2 of Combat Master! Please enjoy tons of new content: new maps, new weapons, new Operators, new play styles, new stories, and new surprises!  Let's gooooooooooo!

Claim 100 Battle Pass Season 2 Rewards
With the S2 Battle Pass, more than 100 rewards await you. Things start gold with instant reward legendary Akimbo bundle. From there, you'll earn a whole arsenal of weapons, XP, avatars, free CP, and more, culminating in the ultimate medieval operator: the Crusader!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/eddcf8ab79a63d2009a43e2a266f94476672a7e3.jpg
The S2 BP bundled collections are inspired by many themes and colors! Will you blister your enemies with the Dark Inferno or practice some stylish sniping with the High Fashion Milan? The Battle Pass offers something for every player and play-style.

Drop in on the New Blitz Battle Royale Map!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/0a9825059f17a1742ac6ca5f8db80146467fbf43.jpg
Somewhere in the North Sea, the New Oil Platform awaits! Are you ready to brave the freezing wind and water of the newest Combat Zone map? This time with extremely dynamic fights and new level optimizations for your highest FPS!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/f7c01c6f10f88ead28c547885e7a9f386356e720.jpg
The Oil Platform brings with it a new Blitz Royale mode -- it's a Battle Royale mode with a pace to match the frantic whistling of the wind.  Can you be king of the Rig as the gas circles get closer and closer, faster and faster?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/1aae5ccfc5b75b1f040a48169b93969daa604282.jpg
This time earn your way back from two Gulags! Upper Deck with large open space and Jet Fighter or Lower Deck with tight space and Speed Boat. Get back and with the match!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/876c7ff5e19f30049254bd5e342b177f892016e2.jpg
Drop onto the North Platform, snipe from the Wind Turbines, slink across the Tanker, and deal death from the Main Deck. The Twin Cruisers and Aircraft Carrier also join the party! Many new POIs are ready for your exploration and stylish frags! See you on the new Oil Platforms!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/be94cc9d175dc4e2dfdac6df0186f6c6d7421806.jpg
Use the 24/7 Oil Platforms Combat Zone game filter, to enjoy the non-stop fight for the last man standing on the Rig!

Akimbo and more!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/9ebf561e214796da6e9b9ae2d5b39bbfd5522f25.jpg
At long last, dual wielding has shot into Combat Master, along with a whole locker full of weapons designed for maximum carnage. Bring out your karambits, butterfly knives, handguns, SMGs, and ARs. It's time to do double damage!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/1c6249721c2a1690168526324d170b1d2db6a697.gif

Equip your new Weapon Perks!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/27af5ba0472156aa4d89a203e8b27ed14f50312e.jpg
Much requested by our community, you can now fine-tune your weapons to match your playstyle and goals. Will you choose a more stable shot?  A longer range?  Or perhaps a bit more XP to unlock the next Battle Pass reward?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/2d9f040afaacf6b5e0d5f612cb83830457820a66.jpg
All Weapon Perks are now available in the Weapon Gunsmith Setup and they are: FMJ  -  Sleight of Hand  -  Wounding  -  Heavy Hitter  -  Fully Loaded  -  Akimbo  -  Extra XP  -  Stability  -  Long SHot  -  Hollow Point. Go try them now!

New Weapon Shotstorm SG
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/8e22f03f3de7b1841116ba19d6da6ccadf1e8465.jpg
Take a shotgun, narrow the scatter, and extend the range from here to Hell.  With these guns equipped, you'll be the one bringing the storm.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/ba692349e5a3c927c6024c0839371b6d83e1e6f2.jpg
Let some Secrets haunt your enemies, get cutesy with the UwU, or make your barrage pretty damn pretty with the Sequin and many more new Shot Storm ModKits!

Black Market Cases are here!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/15df11b9db5bad8765e15dcdd0871abb245e59b6.jpg
What? Cases in Combat Master? Hear me out ‘)) Now you can get items from previous seasons and many new ones in the exciting carousel of Black Market Cases. And CP for this, you can grind free in Operations, BP and Daily Rewards!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/b042f7ab5245f4d97cd68f896d3a8a7fa457a9c8.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/54ffc9b336b4c812a212f702edc3e4a0cd3ea14e.jpg
Do you love the attention of cuties? Then Open the first Anime Case Cutie Paaaaaws! These items will be the ~purrrrrfect~ additions to make you the coolest cat around! And we got more than that!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/4eccf0438b9da784d6c746008ca2dcee7dea7e62.jpg
Open 10 more cases with your favorite and new items! Pay attention to the most honest drops in the history of cases! Sure -- every item in the case is super top!

Start the New Operations!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/807db8f02a8f85ab24ccf06322fa7b8c83f62fa1.jpg
Every Operator has a million stories to tell about their missions. And now it's up to you to help tell them. In Operations, you'll be playing the roles of Operators both new and familiar as they seek to accomplish their objectives. Make their choices. Fight their foes. You're the one who tells the story of how they come back successful and alive.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/f0f92343c8a32b836d80dca315c4b133021ce8c2.jpg
Three new Operations are now available for you! Each Operation follows a unique storyline, and you'll complete gameplay goals to keep moving the story forward. If you can survive all the way to victory, you'll be rewarded with new weapons and gear! Start operation now!

Operation: Lone Wolf
It was a perfectly safe airplane.
I jumped out of it anyway.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/dca62fca11baf726da29eb8c656eb4dc0f7507f0.jpg
Intel suggests Bravo has a base hidden deep in the forest, far away from any known roads or trails.  Our newest Operator Hunter is expertly poised for survival and tracking in the wilds--alone.  Will you find the base or instead find yourself rimrocked in a dangerous canyon?  Only you and the pilot you don't necessarily like will know for sure.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/3da755d384b905359f5cc1b6fa469525d4fd17a5.jpg
The story unfolds as you radio your reports back to HQ. Who the hell is this crazy farmer? What the hell is chicken in the woods? Why the hell aren't you somewhere where they serve beer? The choices you make will help answer these questions and guide Hunter closer to finding--and neutralizing--the Bravo base.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/8202f6379ed9157dd221d79f28fa4f076eb974ec.gif

Lone Wolf Bundle
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/06919db9885e2378b8c205aed6f6a6ed113b1b6b.jpg
Hunter doesn't necessarily appreciate companions, except for those that might be able to help him survive and eliminate his enemies. This suite of weapons and tactical gear are designed to do just that.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/1474e1c76afd47252b3c244314729b7752b6f6ab.jpg

Operation: Cobra Queen
B.I.T.E. needs me to run a quick extraction in Morocco.
Might even have time to do some sightseeing.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/d60b8ccd52564cbec203919a1463c1d4a89aea2e.jpg
Your fellow agent Kestrel has just taken care of a drug lord, and you've been assigned to pick her up. But when you arrive, she isn't at the rendezvous point.  Could the shadowy criminal organization known as Quicksand be behind this?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/2fc1e735a5504e8bbce93c1edac29d0987dce079.jpg
B.I.T.E. is demanding answers and, ideally, Kestrel's safe return. Will you trust a lowlife criminal with your own life, or will you be forever sold to a diamond mining operation?  Your decisions will determine your--and Kestrel's--future.

Cobra Queen Bundle
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/26227564a638effabb94ed1cf4ccfd3454624cc4.jpg
Ideally suited for the harsh Saharan sand and sun, this loadout spits venom and charms all those who dare oppose you.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/d4de98339c98a6289dfdcbe8e378f3098ecd260b.jpg

Operation: Shadow Chase
Rush thinks he's fast. I'm faster.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/34a6b91f2d44c1a9e653f23245877ccc73f6ad64.jpg
Play the role of fan favorite Shadow Rider as she races Rush through urban streets on her road rocket.  There's a satchel of interest to Alfa as well as Octagon.  Do you take it, since you know this city's layout better than anyone? Or do you let Rush take it, since it'll be more fun to see his stupid face after you swipe it from him?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/e0940bfbfb6e2cf588efed7721cc92f2332c879c.jpg
You'll have to make choices faster than the action movie hero.  Maybe you can make better jokes, too.

Complete all Operations with 3 Stars!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/75cdedfdfc02aeb0ac93472dfad518a8a5962c2e.jpg
Finish all missions of an Operation at the highest level, and receive a special golden avatar letting others know that you're the best of the best!

Combat Master Points
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/0486f0329af6eb3d8cade1120f902931a8a40054.jpg
The new in-game currency allows you to outfit yourself with the latest gear, skins, and bling.  And with Daily Challenges, Battle Pass and Operations you can earn CM Points for free by doing all of the epic things you love, now with CP rewards!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/297441a3cace4b71c4befff4ca7308a9a3e05df3.jpg
Get more CP with huge up to 50% bonus and regional discounts. Best prices on the market!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/d9fe00c007739dad5df53e7c5df8e076ebc4787f.jpg
More than 300+ CM Points can be claimed for free daily, meaning you'll soon be on your way to your ideal loadout without spending a dime! Grind your way to riches!

New Vehicle: Paraglider!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/fed651b9895069b83a9548abdbd56d8900e84f3b.jpg
Duel it out in a little air-to-air combat -- CM style!  Attach a fan to a chute and take to the skies as you elude your enemies and use a little force to bring them back down to earth.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/0fb5563b94889621b3bbee193d3929a3555dde2c.jpg
Play with Paragliders in Battle Royale or any other of your favorite maps in Custom Game mode. See all the Combat Master locations from up above!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/c26404dcd8e01eaf3287698ee172596918c712a7.jpg
Paragliders are available 24/7 on the Highrise map for the ultimate in aerial assaults with special Paraglider game mode! Join the battle in the sky!

Customize More: Zipline, Parachute, Paraglider
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/a29ba3fda505fd43389f49971eaf43d7a974db43.jpg
Tweak everything to your exacting specifications with new rollouts of zipline carabiners, chute fabrics, and paraglider sprays. Let your style speak, even for a brief moment, before your weapons do.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/805a34fad860510b030551dce00ccaa4b6871dbf.jpg

Starter Pack: Fever Pitch
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/60086ac97a90c6bb8fed0f050c8dd0658e9257b6.jpg
Looking to get into CM? Look no further than this welcome Starer Pack with 2400 CP bonus, Foreward Operator, heavy fight knuckles, new Shot Storm Shotgun, Akimbo weapons and more! Note: This Bundle weapons have Crimson Red Tracer rounds.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/1e1cfd9fcbd7e7b3a38efcc0bf9fa5bc9abc6d75.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/dd735a2a538438098260c5c10e5596a164cd4d18.jpg

What's New:
Dear Players! Season 2 is here!
- 100 Levels of new S2 rewards!
- New Quick BR Map -- Oil Platforms;
- Play through 3 brand new Operations to get the rewards!
- New Game Mode: 24/7 Paraglider!
- Black Market Cases;
- Weapon Perks: Akimbo and more!
- New Vehicle: Paraglider!
- New Weapon -- Auto Shotgun!
- New Bundles Lone Wolf and Cobra Queen
- Customize your Ziplines and Parachutes;

- Starter Pack with 2400 Combat Points;

- Super Optimizations for the new Quick BR map;
- The New Pokrovsk is getting back in the next release! ')

Thank you for your love and greatest support,
Lets go!
Alfa Bravo Team

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/64d548beeb9c296de727099513720e511ea14199.png

notes.title: Welcome to COMBAT ZONE!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=0DIg2G_BTEs;full][/previewyoutube]
The Combat Zone is here! Drop in from helicopters, gear up, survive the circles and be the last man standing! Use your best Combat Master tactics, weapons and movements -- the challenge is on!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/da8825768497ef1605d53564421505a9d5a12f73.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/b01944d53e1140dbab2132379fa6a5727f0c16df.gif

Explore the whole new map with many POIs and secrets.
The free city of Pokrovsk awaits your arrival -- Welcome to Combat Zone!


The free city of Pokrovsk
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/6f9f1d587a1dd76a3223e2a38494aa7f2d787be6.jpg
The free city of Pokrovsk is now open for you! Drop in at the golden morning lights, foggy daylight or rose-tinded sunset. Experience the glory of Pokrovsk at all times!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/48a0866e4e61acd06879c1728c88acad75e85467.jpg
Explore the many points of interest of Pokrovsk, adopt your playstyle to diverse environments -- whether it's close-quarter clashes in Industrial Zones or long-range sniper duels in Freedom Park, discover your ultimate Combat Zone!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/f4de420611df1d9fe3f8da9336a3be61fb53f492.jpg
Use the 24/7 Combat Zone game filter, to enjoy the non-stop fight for the last man standing!


Buy Station is now open!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/ee50f1bc24f89f95effd1bc7cb6c67cdad04a7ed.jpg
Embark on an epic shopping spree with the new Buy Station! Hunt for cash in every nook and cranny of the Pokrovsk city, snatch some moolah from weapon boxes, and loot those foes you totally outplayed!

Snag Ammo, Armor, Self-Revive, Gas Mask, and the ultimate game-changer -- your beloved Loadout. It's the key to reigning supreme and securing your spot as the Last Man Standing! Time to gear up and dominate!


Free Loadout Drop, twice the match!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/4704c2b3366b3ae6355fd9e5976884c1b6785c71.jpg
Survive the first circle and witness your complimentary Free Loadout Drop descending in your vicinity. Secure your go-to weapons not once, but twice -- swift as the gas in Circle 1 and Circle 5.

Monitor the descent of rival Loadout Drops to catch your adversaries off guard. Turn the tables and seize the advantage!


Fight your way back!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/3122c833425453f667398d8792a04f04962cd03c.jpg
Out of the game? No problem! Embrace your second chance as a Prisoner of the Combat Zone. Battle your way back through a 1v1 Gulag Duel for redeployment -- but tread carefully, as this opportunity knocks only once!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/8636d06e4a8e35f2da427aa39a598d8b8b3c2dc8.jpg
Keep an eye on the Gas Circle upon redeployment -- seize the moment and unleash your revenge!


Survive the gas!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/54805fe8c19a3fdf61ac88459b18dee20a0b17c7.jpg
Secure the Gas Mask to outsmart enemies and prolong your stay in the Circle. The Durable Gas Mask is a rare find -- take your shot for unmatched protection!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/1e3d6c22ce17912640c21c8ce03192968e5df140.jpg
Flank with caution: your Gas Mask wears down quickly! Keep a sharp eye on it's cracks as the Circle tightens it's grip.


Save yourself with Self-Revive Kit
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/486a6430d1c5b470a6c0a3f627e7045b706e41de.jpg
When downed, don't throw in the towel -- unleash the power of the Self-Revive Kit to rise again and win the fight!


Launch yourself in the sky with Jump Pads!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/9022ec55412f77694135f1e606fc9c39863e8d85.jpg

Level up your Combat Zone commute by rocket through the skies with new Jump Pads! Combine them with Parachute to elevate your movement to a new heights!


New Weapon: P90
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/98a2d667fece2b42c577ab5ee3c865f1475620a1.jpg
Get the new P90! Easily recognizable for its unique bullpup design, best for shooting on the move due to its high-capacity magazine and low recoil.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/5ef473bc88b74a3823055dc94c61637b2af4a8f1.jpg
P90 mods feature P20 High-Mobility Prototype Reciever, long-range V-Max Tip Cartridge, Incendiary Dragon Breath Ammo and many more.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/cab716eddf71cc0852ed60d2a829f7800de2695d.jpg


New Weapon: Dual Punch Daggers
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/ae9cf26b6b6a781ac7238033553ac8328dc76769.jpg
Equip the new Dual Punch Daggers when you need to add some power to your punch. Show your knife skills with various breathtaking inspect animations!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/530ea12b044fa847ae15badbee250e33a5ccecae.jpg
"Fists speak the truth, and this truth is sharp!"

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/782058049c22124f9108418b8187b9005595750d.gif


New Masters Camo: Combat Zone Topo
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/f0638bed016b5c25daaf529306701a27dc6bca92.jpg
Outlast your rivals 15 times in Combat Zone to score new epic camo for all your weapons at once! Ready for the challenge? Grind on!


New Street Fighter Operator Package
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/38dc987ac596d44011fd02cd1020758474740260.jpg
Meet Combat Zone warrior, Street Fighter at heart. If you wanna understand the streets, you gotta live them.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/e6e49572eff4fd70f00c5ab2b7d9739b87d27b7e.jpg
Forged in urban fights, only the strongest survive. Join the club! Note: This Bundle weapons has Dragon Breath Fire and Ruby Tracer rounds.

[previewyoutube=8OVwHCCpXas;full][/previewyoutube]
*Let's goooooooooooo!!!!!!!!!*

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/e608dff8cfdd0963a37585d8e2f66606cdb8d563.jpg
Street Fighter operator features Red Combat Zone Parachute with red parachute lines and straps.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/033c742bbece1c734410ceef7eb9ad20af3159c6.jpg
Drop in with style and shoot while gliding on parachute! Use the extra parachute jump to master your parkour!


New version highlights:


 New BR Game Mode -- Combat Zone:
 Large scale map -- Pokrovsk;
 Parachute: shoot while gliding, extra jump!
 Use Buy Stations;
 Get free Loadout Drops;
 Fight your way back from Gulag!
 Survive longer with Gas Mask;
 Self-Revive Kit;
 Jump Pads;
 Custom CZ lobbies;


Offline СZ and Pokrovsk Free Run modes!


 New Weapons: P90 and Dual Punch Daggers.
 New Bundle Street Kid!
 New CZ Topo Master Camo
 Welcome to the Combat Zone!


A huge shoutout to all Combat Master players for your love, patience, and support.
Thank you for being with us on this long journey!
From the Alfa Bravo Team.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/69f553e60289914adcfb20e222fbc2ebb698db97.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/49eed3d9953f106d5772ad6caab5f4e00efa213f.jpg

notes.title: New Demon Slayer Mode is here!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=0JdaQ8W_OyU;full][/previewyoutube]
Introducing Demon Slayer, the thrilling new game mode for FPS fanatics! In this adrenaline-pumping survival experience, you'll face the ultimate choice: Be the merciless Slayer, hunting down every last demon, or embrace the darkness and become a formidable Demon, turning every fallen to dark side!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/a6cf5545ac93cc4e7f4f8fce98602afceff6d23c.png
Use the new Buy Station to survive through the demon outrage! Equip yourself with Armor and Ammo Kits, instant order your favorite Loadout, shred demons with Minigun, revive your teammates with Antidote Dart, boost your speed with Adrenaline or finish the game with Atomic Blast! Show the money and you'll get the goods!


M4 Assault Rifle with mods!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/33f57106e95c01d9cca6bb263e761a51c0b9d8a2.jpg
Lock and load with the all-new M4 Assault Rifle, your ultimate weapon in the battle for dominance! With an arsenal of gunsmith and customization options at your fingertips, the M4 is more than just a firearm; it's a blank canvas for your tactical genius.


New Map: Carribean Night
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/434f9b992c35aa6b1f12aecdf59093befa9acda8.jpg
Welcome to Caribbean Nights, the thrilling version of a new map that transforms the serene Caribbean paradise into a heart-pounding nocturnal battleground! Engage in intense firefights under the moonlit skies, navigate through moonlit beaches, and sneak through shadowy palm groves.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/8ef876b47f800e99bc5011e3f1dc409ef9d9e7bf.jpg
Adapt to the darkness and uncover the secrets of the night. In Caribbean Nights, the beauty of the tropics meets the chaos of warfare!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/7d8093ee4ae18548b81f65a4d584c09e936f03ec.jpg
Use the 24/7 Caribbean Night Demon Slayer game filter, to enjoy the non-stop battle between good and evil!


New Map: Carribean Day
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/fef9af72305167143a76467cd5a7775a2858a3b8.jpg
Escape to Caribbean, the exotic new FPS map that transports you to a sun-soaked paradise ripe for battle! Explore winding coastal village, and engage in intense firefights in this stunning island setting.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/2f1c071032096a570e19df101e7b0ddea234fb95.jpg
With a new 24/7 Caribbean Combat Master game filter, you can enjoy all the non-stop intense combat of Mini Battle Royale mode while you gear up for the release of CombatZone.


New Wolverine Operator Package
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/b894ac0c2b35cbbec76417c36ce8c6cba49b7f5f.jpg
Meet Wolverine, the fearless berserker and ferocious operator perfect for wilderness warfare. Fear the eyes shimmer in the dark.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/460253646f02648b458c680de0c8bb68109193b4.jpg
Unleash your inner beast with feroucious Wolverine operator. Note: This Bundle weapon has Dragon Breath Fire rounds.

[previewyoutube=lSFVj04HB4U;full][/previewyoutube]

Dragon Breath Fire Conversion Kit
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/441fd78620de2b674a2e1262dd7cfca423a85b9d.jpg
Unleash fiery mayhem like never before with incendiary-effect Dragon Breath Fire shotgun shells. This conversion kit turns your trusty M4 assault rifle into a shotgun blazing force of destruction, immolating your foes with every shot. Watch as they scramble in panic amidst the fiery chaos you leave in your wake.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/2c2641e036bcc7c444390b007293e88569e6208a.gif


Master Camos are here!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43498579/a738ba6c8ee597060be10ac3c1a2851229cf9475.jpg
